title: Text panel: use isTextNewFeaturesEnabled() helper, not raw getFeatureFlagClient calls
answers: Where is the text.newFeatures flag checked
How to add a new feature behind the text panel's newFeatures flag
Avoid duplicating getFeatureFlagClient boolean checks in the text panel
body:
Convention: all checks of the text.newFeatures flag go through `isTextNewFeaturesEnabled()` in public/app/plugins/panel/text/v2/utils.ts, which calls getFeatureFlagClient().getBooleanValue(FlagKeys.TextNewFeatures, false). Previously each file (module.tsx, renderContent.ts, TextNGHtmlView.tsx, TextNGFormatToolbar.tsx) duplicated the raw call with a hardcoded 'text.newFeatures' string, risking drift. The flag is read fresh on every call (not cached/memoized) since its value can change after providers settle.
Fix pattern: when adding a new flag-gated code path in this panel, import and call isTextNewFeaturesEnabled() rather than calling getFeatureFlagClient() directly or hardcoding the flag name; use the FlagKeys enum, not a string literal.
Constraints: specific to the text/v2 panel package; other panels have their own flag-check conventions.
applies: public/app/plugins/panel/text/v2/** when gating code behind the text.newFeatures flag
